reference.method: the outcome each rule of the documentation gives; a number computed with mpmath at 50 significant digits (the Binomial by exact fractions)

functions.name: K_STATS_NormalStandard_Cumulative
functions.domain: Any finite Z. Far in the upper tail the result is 1: the tail is below Double resolution, use Survival.

functions.name: K_STATS_NormalStandard_Survival
functions.domain: Any finite Z. The upper tail is computed directly, never as 1 - Cumulative; beyond about Z = 38 it is below the Double range and returns 0.

functions.name: K_STATS_NormalStandard_InverseCumulative
functions.domain: Probability strictly between 0 and 1: 0 and 1 return #NUM!.

functions.name: K_STATS_NormalStandard_IntervalProbability
functions.domain: UpperZ not below LowerZ: bounds in the wrong order return #NUM!.

functions.name: K_STATS_Normal_Density
functions.domain: StdDev > 0; |X|, |Mean| and StdDev below 1E100. A density too small for a Double is 0.

functions.name: K_STATS_Normal_Cumulative
functions.domain: StdDev > 0; |X|, |Mean| and StdDev below 1E100. Outside these: #NUM!.

functions.name: K_STATS_Normal_InverseCumulative
functions.domain: Probability strictly between 0 and 1 (0.95, not 95); StdDev > 0; |Mean| and StdDev below 1E100.

functions.name: K_STATS_Lognormal_Mean
functions.domain: StdDevLog > 0; |MeanLog| and StdDevLog below 1E100. A mean beyond the largest Double returns #NUM!.

functions.name: K_STATS_StudentT_Cumulative
functions.domain: DegreesFreedom > 0 and at most 1E8; it need not be a whole number.

functions.name: K_STATS_StudentT_InverseCumulative
functions.domain: Probability strictly between 0 and 1; DegreesFreedom > 0 and at most 1E8.

functions.name: K_STATS_ChiSquare_Density
functions.domain: DegreesFreedom > 0. Below 0 the density is 0; at X = 0 it is unbounded, #NUM!, when DegreesFreedom < 2.

functions.name: K_STATS_Gamma_Density
functions.domain: Shape > 0 and at most 1E20, ScaleParam > 0 (a scale, not a rate). At X = 0 unbounded, #NUM!, when Shape < 1.

functions.name: K_STATS_Gamma_Cumulative
functions.domain: Shape > 0 and ScaleParam > 0 (a scale, not a rate). Below 0 the result is 0.

functions.name: K_STATS_Gamma_InverseCumulative
functions.domain: Probability strictly between 0 and 1; Shape > 0; ScaleParam > 0. A quantile below the Double range is 0.

functions.name: K_STATS_Beta_Density
functions.domain: Alpha > 0 and Beta > 0. Unbounded, #NUM!, at X = 0 when Alpha < 1 and at X = 1 when Beta < 1.

functions.name: K_STATS_Beta_Cumulative
functions.domain: Alpha > 0 and Beta > 0. Below 0 the result is 0 and above 1 it is 1: the natural limits, not errors.

functions.name: K_STATS_Exponential_Density
functions.domain: Lambda > 0 (a rate, not a scale). Below 0 the density is 0.

functions.name: K_STATS_Exponential_Survival
functions.domain: Lambda > 0 (a rate, not a scale). Below 0 the result is 1.

functions.name: K_STATS_Uniform_Cumulative
functions.domain: LowerBound < UpperBound. Outside the bounds the result is 0 or 1.

functions.name: K_STATS_Binomial_PMF
functions.domain: Counts are truncated toward zero. NumberSuccesses from 0 to Trials; ProbSuccess from 0 to 1.

functions.name: K_STATS_Binomial_Cumulative
functions.domain: Counts are truncated toward zero. NumberSuccesses from 0 to Trials; ProbSuccess from 0 to 1; Trials up to 10,000,000.

functions.name: K_STATS_Binomial_InverseCumulative
functions.domain: Probability strictly between 0 and 1; ProbSuccess strictly between 0 and 1; Trials up to 10,000,000.

functions.name: K_STATS_Poisson_PMF
functions.domain: NumberEvents from 0, truncated toward zero; Mean not negative.

functions.name: K_STATS_Poisson_Cumulative
functions.domain: NumberEvents from 0, truncated toward zero; Mean not negative and at most 10,000,000.

functions.name: K_STATS_Hypergeometric_PMF
functions.domain: SampleSize and PopulationSuccesses at most PopulationSize. A count the population makes impossible returns #NUM!.

functions.name: K_STATS_DiscreteUniform_PMF
functions.domain: LowerBound not above UpperBound. Outside the support, or at a value that is not whole, the mass is 0.

functions.name: K_STATS_DiscreteUniform_LogPMF
functions.domain: LowerBound not above UpperBound. Where the mass is 0 its logarithm is undefined: #NUM!.

functions.name: K_STATS_DiscreteUniform_Cumulative
functions.domain: LowerBound not above UpperBound. Any real X: a step function, 0 below the support and 1 above it.

cases.title: A valid call
cases.rule: 9.1: a call that succeeds returns a number.
cases.cause: P(X <= 1.5) for a standard Normal.
cases.action: Nothing to correct.

cases.title: Below a continuous support
cases.rule: 7.8: continuous distributions return the natural limit and no error.
cases.cause: The Beta lives on 0 to 1: no mass lies below -0.5.
cases.action: Nothing to correct: 0 is the answer, not an error.

cases.title: Above a continuous support
cases.rule: 7.8: above the support the cumulative probability is 1.
cases.cause: All of the Uniform(0, 10) lies below 12.
cases.action: Nothing to correct.

cases.title: A density outside the support
cases.rule: 7.8: below the support the density is 0.
cases.cause: The Exponential has no mass below 0.
cases.action: Nothing to correct.

cases.title: The top of a discrete support
cases.rule: 7.8: k = n is in the Binomial support; P(X <= n) = 1.
cases.cause: Ten successes in ten trials is the largest count.
cases.action: Nothing to correct.

cases.title: A count truncated toward zero
cases.rule: 7.6: count arguments are truncated toward zero, 2.9 is read as 2.
cases.cause: The mass of 2 events, not of 2.9.
cases.action: Pass whole counts to avoid the surprise.

cases.title: A Discrete Uniform at a real X
cases.rule: 7.6: the Discrete Uniform cumulative accepts any real X, a step function.
cases.cause: Six of the nine integers from -3 to 5 are at most 2.8.
cases.action: Nothing to correct.

cases.title: A Discrete Uniform outside its support
cases.rule: 7.6: the Discrete Uniform PMF returns 0 outside the support.
cases.cause: 20 is not one of the integers from 0 to 10.
cases.action: Nothing to correct; its LogPMF is #NUM! (below).

cases.title: A density too small for a Double
cases.rule: 9.4: 0 for a density far in a tail, the true value is too small for a Double.
cases.cause: The true value, about 1.5E-348, is below the smallest Double.
cases.action: Work with logarithms if the size matters.

cases.title: A cumulative probability rounded to 1
cases.rule: 9.4: 1 for a cumulative probability whose upper tail is below Double resolution.
cases.cause: The true value is 1 - 7.6E-24, stored as 1.
cases.action: For the upper tail call Survival, as in the next case.

cases.title: The same tail, kept by Survival
cases.rule: 7.3: every distribution has a Survival function that computes the upper tail directly.
cases.cause: P(Z > 10) about 7.6E-24, which 1 - Cumulative loses.
cases.action: Use Survival for a small upper tail.

cases.title: A Gamma quantile below the Double range
cases.rule: 9.4: 0 for a Gamma quantile whose true value is below the Double range.
cases.cause: With Shape 0.01 the 1E-300 quantile is about 1E-30000.
cases.action: Nothing to correct: 0 is the nearest Double.

cases.title: Probability 0 in an inverse
cases.rule: 7.5: every inverse requires a probability strictly between 0 and 1.
cases.cause: The 0-quantile of the Normal is minus infinity.
cases.action: Pass a probability strictly between 0 and 1.

cases.title: Probability 1 in an inverse
cases.rule: 7.5: the values 0 and 1 return #NUM!.
cases.cause: The 1-quantile of a Student t is plus infinity.
cases.action: Pass a probability strictly between 0 and 1.

cases.title: A probability typed as a percentage
cases.rule: 7.1: enter 5 percent as 0.05, not as 5.
cases.cause: 95 is not a probability: 95% is 0.95.
cases.action: Divide by 100: pass 0.95.

cases.title: A zero standard deviation
cases.rule: 6.1: StdDev must be strictly positive.
cases.cause: A Normal with no spread has no density.
cases.action: Pass a positive StdDev.

cases.title: A negative shape
cases.rule: 6.3: shape, scale and rate parameters must be strictly positive.
cases.cause: No Gamma has a negative shape.
cases.action: Pass a positive Shape.

cases.title: Uniform bounds in the wrong order
cases.rule: 6.3: LowerBound must be less than UpperBound.
cases.cause: The bounds are swapped: 10 is not below 0.
cases.action: Swap the bounds: Uniform_Cumulative(5,0,10).

cases.title: An interval with its bounds swapped
cases.rule: 9.2: an interval with the upper bound below the lower bound.
cases.cause: The upper bound -1 is below the lower bound 1.
cases.action: Pass the bounds in order: (-1, 1).

cases.title: A negative count
cases.rule: 7.8: discrete distributions are stricter, a negative count returns #NUM!.
cases.cause: A count of events cannot be negative.
cases.action: For P(X < 0) = 0 give the answer directly, as in 7.2.

cases.title: A count above the number of trials
cases.rule: 7.8: a Binomial count above Trials returns #NUM!.
cases.cause: Twelve successes cannot occur in ten trials.
cases.action: Keep NumberSuccesses from 0 to Trials.

cases.title: A success probability above 1
cases.rule: 9.5: ProbSuccess must be between 0 and 1.
cases.cause: 1.35 is not a probability.
cases.action: Pass ProbSuccess from 0 to 1.

cases.title: An unbounded density at an endpoint
cases.rule: 6.3: the Beta density at X = 0 returns #NUM! when Alpha < 1.
cases.cause: The density grows without bound as X falls to 0.
cases.action: Ask for a probability (Cumulative) instead.

cases.title: The logarithm of a zero mass
cases.rule: 7.6: when the outcome has probability exactly zero, LogPMF returns #NUM!.
cases.cause: The mass of 20 is 0, and ln(0) has no finite value.
cases.action: Check the support first; the PMF gives 0.

cases.title: Degrees of freedom above the limit
cases.rule: 6.2: Student t cumulative degrees of freedom above 1E8 return #NUM!.
cases.cause: 1E9 is above the tested limit of 1E8.
cases.action: Use the Normal, which the t approaches.

cases.title: A location of 1E100 or more
cases.rule: 9.2: location, scale or shape of size 1E100 or more, where checked.
cases.cause: Mean = 1E100 is outside the supported magnitude.
cases.action: Rescale the problem.

cases.title: A moment beyond the largest Double
cases.rule: 9.2: a quantile or moment beyond the largest Double.
cases.cause: exp(800.5) is above 1.8E308.
cases.action: Work with MeanLog: ln of the mean is MeanLog + StdDevLog^2 / 2.

cases.title: A text argument
cases.rule: PUBLIC_API.md: a text returns #VALUE!; Excel refuses to convert it before the function is called.
cases.cause: The function never runs; Excel gives #VALUE!.
cases.action: Enter a number, not text.

cases.title: An empty cell read as 0
cases.rule: PUBLIC_API.md: an empty cell returns what 0 returns.
cases.cause: The empty X is read as 0, so the answer is P(X <= 0) = 0.5.
cases.action: Fill the cell: an empty input gives no error.

cases.title: An empty cell as a probability
cases.rule: PUBLIC_API.md: an empty cell returns what 0 returns; 7.5: a probability of 0 returns #NUM!.
cases.cause: The empty cell is read as probability 0.
cases.action: Fill the cell with a probability.
